name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells two your shoulders.
Lower the kettlebell and immediately press the other kettlebell. Make sure to do the same amount of reps on both sides.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Kettlebell Seesaw Press is an intermediate pushing exercise for the front delts, performed with a kettlebell. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
